places.normalized: Three Jolly Bargemen inn, Hubberds Hole area, Kent (fictional village of Dickens's Marshes setting)
places.quote: Joe had been at the Three Jolly Bargemen, smoking his pipe, from a quarter after eight o’clock to a quarter before ten.
places.note: Fictional inn; location within the novel's Kent marshland village, cannot be pinned on a real map.

places.normalized: Thames prison hulks, Thames estuary (near Gravesend/Chatham, Kent)
places.quote: The hue and cry going off to the Hulks, and people coming thence to examine the iron
places.note: Prison ships moored in the Thames estuary and Medway; the name refers to the hulks collectively.

The Constables and the Bow Street men from London
places.note: Refers to Bow Street police officers, named after their office location.
